title: fix: persist Mouse Without Borders security key edits

status.label: Two validated security-key inline suggestions
status.detail: Two independently grounded inline suggestions correct the settings parameter type and persist accepted security keys independently of live-session equality, including case-only edits. The exact combined literal passed a forced production rebuild, test-project rebuild and both focused regression tests; the newly compiled production assembly matched the copy used by the tests. All three final processes drained naturally to zero owned children. The independent type-only compile exited zero but required forced owned-helper cleanup. These are validated review drafts, not a clean automated review or full-application/UI validation; the eight-request limit is exhausted.

next_action: Review the two pinned inline suggestions and explicitly decide whether to post them. No upstream action has been taken.

confidence.rationale: The defect follows directly from the current guard, the setup caller runtime-only mutation, the reload path, and PBKDF2 exact string input.

proposed_comments.body:
**[P1] Qualify the settings parameter type so the application compiles**

`Settings` resolves to the referenced `Settings` namespace rather than the imported `MouseWithoutBorders.Class.Settings` type here, producing CS0118. Qualify the parameter type; this keeps the existing caller and method behavior unchanged.

```suggestion
        internal static bool TryApplySecurityKey(global::MouseWithoutBorders.Class.Settings settings, string newKey, out string error)
```
